_comment: Single source of truth for every research report (review G12). Drives the internal dashboard's Reports section, the internal sidebar's Reports category, the Pages worker's GATED_REPORTS and DEFAULT_PUBLIC_REPORTS blocks (via scripts/gen-report-registry.mjs, run automatically before every build), and the precheck's registry-consistency checks. Fields: slug (row id), name (dashboard card title), sidebarName (shorter sidebar label; defaults to name), desc (dashboard card description), href (dashboard link), internal (sidebar link; null = not in the sidebar), publicSlug + publicPath (KV visibility toggle; omit for internal-only pages), defaultPublic (serve 200 before any KV flag is written; Maze partner editions only), dataFolder (study folder under research-projects/Interview Projects, when the report binds to pipeline data), precheckSkip (named precheck rules this legacy report is exempt from; new reports must not use this).

reports.name: UK Neobank Switching Study
reports.desc: Two-wave UK retail banking study: 120 switchers to Monzo or Starling Bank + 200 non-switchers at top-5 incumbents. Three-chapter narrative (Why They Left, How It's Going, Who's Next) plus retiree spotlight and 3-stakeholder recommendations. Simulated data; pipeline validation run.

reports.name: Intercom Fin-on-Top Strategic Study
reports.desc: B2B two-cohort study (60 Fin Adopters + 120 aware Non-Adopters) on Intercom's Fin-on-Top motion. Tests whether Fin-on-Top converts adopters to full Intercom replatform (answer: largely no, 60% of adopters lean against). 71% of aware Non-Adopters name Fin as their likely AI-agent choice within 12 months. Simulated data; methodology demo.

reports.desc: Maze-branded version of the Intercom Fin-on-Top Strategic Study for partner-assisted distribution. Same content, Maze-styled chrome (cover, logo, fonts); BuyerVoice attribution in the cover POWERED BY line. Defaults to public.

reports.name: The Retinol Graduation Moment
reports.desc: B2C study (240 US women aged 35-43) on switching from Olay Regenerist Retinol 24 to either Olay Retinol 24 MAX (upgraders) or a competitor brand (defectors). Decodes the channel + trigger + decision-logic asymmetry between the two arms; recommends a serum-format step-up retinoid and a TikTok dermatologist creator program. Simulated data; pipeline validation run.

reports.name: The Retinol Graduation Moment (Maze edition)
reports.desc: Maze-branded version of The Retinol Graduation Moment for partner-assisted distribution. Same content, Maze-styled chrome (cover, logo, fonts); BuyerVoice attribution in the cover POWERED BY line. Defaults to public.

reports.name: Applied Generative AI Course Concept
reports.desc: B2B concept test (50 GTA professionals) of a proposed 8-week online university certificate teaching non-technical professionals to use generative AI, priced at $3,000. Concept lands broadly (96% positive); the decision turns on price and who funds it (96% say funding shapes it, 88% prefer employer-funded). Intent-cohort analysis of likely vs unsure buyers, plus fear-vs-opportunity framing findings. Simulated data; methodology demo.
